# Properties Collection

API methods to work with Properties

**Property** is a physical premises – hotels, motels, lodges, cabins, chalets, luxury apartments and other types of buildings. Usually each property has a unique address.

{% hint style="info" %}
Don't combine multiple properties into one, it's better they are all created separately with their own address and details
{% endhint %}

## Properties API

You are able to download OpenAPI Spec for this endpoint [here](https://openapi.gitbook.com/o/-LWLG7_8Oqm5JM-68Pw_/spec/properties-api.json).

## List properties

> List properties. Results are paginated; the \`meta\` block carries the page, limit, total and ordering. Without \`pagination\[…]\` and \`order\[…]\`, the first 10 properties are returned ordered by title ascending.

## Update a property

## Delete a property

> Delete a property by its identifier. Deletion is permanent — a removed property cannot be restored.
